prompt: Redesign the supplied dashboard.html into out/index.html. Keep every data value and label, but make the interface feel intentionally designed and production-ready. It must work from 390px through 1440px, use accessible semantic HTML, preserve visible focus states, and avoid gradients, excessive cards, pill-shaped containers, and decorative dashboard clutter. Use no external assets or libraries. Explain the visual system in out/design-notes.md.
rubric: The redesign preserves the source information while establishing clear hierarchy, purposeful typography and spacing, restrained surfaces, responsive behavior, and accessible interaction states. It should look authored rather than like a generic card dashboard.

source_failure.signature: frontend redesigns default to generic cards gradients pills and weak hierarchy
